summary.summary: Target CPA is underperforming at $68 actual vs $50 target (36% over), with a worsening trend. The switch from Manual CPC actually increased CPA from $60 to $68. Data volume is borderline (42 conv/month) and campaign fragmentation is diluting the signal. Recommend reverting to Manual CPC or consolidating campaigns.

monthly_conversions.note: Borderline - meets minimum but not comfortable

data_sufficiency.verdict: Borderline - meets technical minimums but performance suggests insufficient signal

trend.note: CPA increasing week-over-week - strategy is degrading, not optimizing

vs_previous_strategy.verdict: Smart Bidding performing WORSE than Manual CPC

contributing_factors.evidence: 3 campaigns splitting 42 conversions = ~14 per campaign, well below threshold
Brand CPA ($30) vs Competitor CPA ($116) - algorithm trying to optimize across vastly different economics

contributing_factors.factor: Target may be unrealistic for non-brand
contributing_factors.evidence: Non-brand campaigns at $85-116 CPA cannot hit $50 target, dragging portfolio down

diagnosis.data_shows: The algorithm is being asked to hit $50 CPA across campaigns with fundamentally different conversion economics. Brand can hit $30, but non-brand is 2-3x higher. The single target is impossible to achieve blended.

option_a.name: Revert to Manual CPC
option_a.what: Switch back to Manual CPC bidding
option_a.why: Previous Manual CPC performance ($60 CPA) was better than current Target CPA ($68). With only 42 conversions/month split across 3 campaigns, data volume is insufficient for Smart Bidding to optimize.
option_a.expected_impact: CPA reduction of ~$8 (12%) based on historical performance

option_b.name: Consolidate + Different Targets
option_b.what: Merge non-brand campaigns into one, set separate targets: Brand at $35, Non-brand at $75
option_b.why: More data per campaign, realistic targets for each. If you need Smart Bidding, this gives it a chance to work.
option_b.expected_impact: Should stabilize CPA within targets, may improve over time
option_b.risk: Loses granular control of competitor targeting

recommendations.what_not_to_do: Don't lower the target to $40-45 hoping to force better performance. This typically causes impression share collapse as the algorithm realizes it can't hit the target.

if_switching_to_manual: Step 1: Calculate current avg CPC by campaign (use as starting bids)
Step 2: Switch to Manual CPC - do all campaigns same day
Step 3: Set bids at calculated avg CPC
Step 4: Monitor daily for 3 days, adjust bids if impression share drops significantly
Step 5: Weekly bid optimization based on keyword performance

success_metrics.primary: CPA should stabilize at $60-65 within 2 weeks
success_metrics.secondary: Impression share should remain stable (not drop >10%)

transition_plan.rollback_criteria: If CPA exceeds $75 for 2 consecutive weeks, re-evaluate strategy

watch_items: Competitor campaign efficiency - may need to pause if CPA doesn't improve with any strategy
Conversion volume trends - if conversions increase to 60+/month, reconsider Smart Bidding
